name: flavour-carousel
title: Flavour Carousel
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A product hero for anything that comes in flavours: the product stands in a mountain of powder against a moss backdrop and its flavours flank it on four tilted cream tiles. It rises from behind the powder spinning and settles; then every five seconds, or on a click, the chosen tile slides into the cup and the cup cross-fades to that flavour without moving; a glow takes the flavour's colour, a price pill and add-to-cart hang under the cup. One component for both themes: in dark mode the tiles go translucent black.
docs: Named export: FlavourCarousel. Composed from the button item, which installs alongside it. Pass `flavours` ({ name, price?, tint?, product, tile }[] — every product image must share the same crop), `heading`, `interval` in ms (0 turns autoplay off), `initial`, `reveal` (in-view, immediate or none), `onChange` and `onAdd` (omit it to hide the cart button) with `addLabel`. `backgroundImage` is the backdrop and `foregroundImage` the transparent powder cutout laid in front of the cup (`foregroundHeight` of the stage tall); without them the scene is drawn from `background`, `mound` ([light, dark]) and `paper`.
